name: Meshech
overview: Meshech is a male biblical figure identified as a son of Japheth, one of the sons of Noah. His lineage places him within the post-flood genealogical records that trace the nations descending from Noah's sons. Beyond his designation as Japheth’s son, Scripture does not provide additional personal details or tribal affiliations.
namesAndTitles: The name Meshech appears as a proper name in the biblical record without an explicit meaning given. It is not indicated that the name was given directly by God, and no additional titles are associated with him in Scripture.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Meshech as a son of Japheth, establishing his place in the genealogical line descending from Noah. Other family relationships are not detailed beyond this paternal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Meshech's significance lies primarily in his role within the genealogical framework that outlines the descendants of Noah through Japheth. This lineage is foundational for understanding the distribution of nations and peoples after the flood, as presented in Genesis 10:2. His mention underscores the biblical emphasis on family lines and the unfolding of God's providential plan through successive generations.
